note: Transition downloads by default, Ingredients with AUTO_DOWNLOAD_ADAPTERS, and CrossView, Relight and Day to Night with scripts/download-adapter-models.sh. Entries marked base_model ltx-2.3 are LTX-2.3 files with no 2.5 build, and are unverified on 2.5. Everything else stays unavailable until its exact checkpoint and graph compatibility is verified.

adapters.name: Ingredients — Character and Scene Continuity
adapters.conditioning: LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide + repeat reference-sheet frames + crop guide frames after sampling

adapters.name: Scene Transition
adapters.conditioning: none: a plain LoRA after the model loader, off at strength 0

adapters.name: CrossView Prompt — Camera Angle
adapters.conditioning: LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide + the source clip as the guide + crop guide frames after sampling

adapters.name: Relight
adapters.conditioning: LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide + the source clip with a light-direction ball in the corner of every frame + crop guide frames after sampling

adapters.name: Day to Night
adapters.conditioning: LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide + the source clip as the guide + crop guide frames after sampling

adapters.name: SDR to HDR
adapters.status: not-provisioned; specialised color pipeline and output requirements
